item.text: `Roles.Check` already rejects unknown values through `Role.Check`, but it has no duplicate check. `Equals` compares slice lengths and only checks membership in one direction, which explains the false positives. I’m checking the defined roles and callers before patching.

The patch is in place. `Check` now tracks roles it has seen, and `Equals` compares distinct-role sets. I’ve added cases for duplicates, unknown roles, nil and empty lists, and equal-length lists with different distinct roles. I’ll format the files and run the existing role tests.
